description: What the main window may call. Custom `#[tauri::command]`s need no permission; this is Tauri's own core API surface at its default, plus the one plugin the app registers. `opener:allow-open-url` is granted rather than `opener:default`, which would also carry `allow-reveal-item-in-dir` (a file-manager call knobas never makes) and `allow-default-urls` (which adds `mailto:` and `tel:`). The scope is the second wall behind `openExternal`'s own scheme check: `web_url` is data an adapter mirrored from a remote system, and `file://` or `vscode://` reaching the OS opener would be a remote-code path that starts in somebody's backlog.
